optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading strategies.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and ensure they are correctly configured and operational.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and take corrective measures such as load balancing or scaling resources.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, slow performance, and potential downtime, affecting trading operations.
